lines.text: The writer says the law is spiritual, but he is unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.
Paul says that if he does what he does not want to do, he admits the law is unfair.
The writer says nothing good lives in his flesh, and he keeps doing the evil he does not want.
He delights in God's law inwardly, but another law in his body wars against the law of his heart.
The writer asks who will rescue him from this body of death, then thanks God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
